name: ha-guardrail
description: Enforces the Home Assistant automations.yaml invariant across GitOps, VS Code, XPipe, and cluster nodes.
author: Thomas

commands.title: Validate automations.yaml
commands.description: Runs the guardrail validator to ensure automations.yaml contains a valid YAML list. Execute from repository root.

commands.title: Repair automations.yaml
commands.description: Repairs automations.yaml by replacing invalid content with [].

commands.title: Run Guardrail Suite
commands.description: Runs validation and repairs automations.yaml if needed. Execute from repository root.

commands.title: Run Ansible Guardrail Role
commands.description: Executes the ha_guardrail Ansible role across all nodes.

commands.title: Run XPipe Guardrail
commands.description: Executes the XPipe guardrail command pack.
